description: Topic selection, audience research, and idea generation strategies

principles.rule: A single video in a popular area of interest can match 1000+ videos in an unpopular area
principles.implication: Spend 5+ days researching before committing to a topic. Never rush ideation.

principles.rule: Ideas must be BROAD — attractive to most people in your niche, not super specific
principles.implication: If only a tiny subset of your audience would care, the idea ceiling is too low.

principles.rule: If you cannot create a compelling title and thumbnail BEFORE making the video, the idea is not viable
principles.implication: Title/thumbnail is the litmus test for idea quality. Build them first.

principles.rule: Ideas are unique combinations of existing information — the more diverse your knowledge, the more unique your ideas
principles.implication: Research broadly beyond your niche. Cross-pollinate concepts.

audience_research.description: Find what your audience actually wants
steps: Go to YouTube Studio > Analytics > Audience to find channels/videos your audience watches
Collect top 15 most-viewed videos from each channel your audience watches
Add relevant channels from the suggested/related column
Sort by most viewed and identify patterns: recurring topics, pain points, goals, attention-grabbing words
Create a research checklist of everything to study
audience_research.time_investment: At least 1 hour building the initial list

steps: Research everything related to your audience's concepts, subjects, pain points, wants, and needs
Keep a notebook, review notes daily
Best brainstorming technique: set alarm earlier than usual, skim notes for 2 minutes, go back to sleep, hit snooze repeatedly — the half-asleep state is the creativity sweet spot

outlier_concept_transfer.description: Find viral concepts from other niches and transfer them
steps: Find outlier videos (way more views than channel average) OUTSIDE your niche
Extract the CONCEPT (not the subject) from the outlier
Transfer that concept to your audience's interests
Use ChatGPT to generate search phrases matching your audience's desires
Search those phrases on outlier-finding tools
outlier_concept_transfer.critical_mistake: Assuming any outlier concept works for your audience. The concept must match what your audience actually cares about (helpful vs entertaining vs interesting).

trend_riding.description: Study trends and popular videos, then twist them
steps: Monitor trending topics in your niche
Take existing popular ideas a step further or add a twist
Combine trending concepts with your unique angle

four_test_validation.description: Every idea must pass all 4 tests before production begins

tests.name: fresh_perspective_test
tests.description: Write ideas down, wait a few days, only keep the ones you still feel good about
tests.automation_hint: Score ideas, shelve for 48h, re-score. Drop >50% delta.

tests.name: originality_test
tests.description: Search YouTube for your would-be title. If it exists, improve the title/thumbnail or add a twist.
tests.automation_hint: YouTube search API — check for title overlap, Jaccard similarity.

tests.name: best_option_test
tests.description: Aim for ideas with at least 5-10x outlier score potential. Only take the top 10% of your ideas.
tests.automation_hint: Compare estimated view potential against channel baseline.

tests.name: title_thumbnail_test
tests.description: Make the title and thumbnail BEFORE making the video. If you cannot create a clear connection between your audience's motivations and the video's value, the idea will not work.
tests.automation_hint: Generate title + thumbnail concepts. Score against titles_thumbnails.json checklist.

anti_patterns.mistake: Picking topics that are too niche or specific
anti_patterns.consequence: View ceiling is capped regardless of execution quality
anti_patterns.fix: Broaden the angle — make it relevant to the majority of your audience

anti_patterns.mistake: Skipping the title/thumbnail test and going straight to production
anti_patterns.consequence: Investing hours in a video nobody will click on
anti_patterns.fix: Always create title + thumbnail concepts before writing the script

anti_patterns.mistake: Assuming an outlier concept from another niche automatically works for yours
anti_patterns.consequence: The concept-audience mismatch leads to low CTR despite high production quality
anti_patterns.fix: Verify the concept maps to what YOUR audience cares about (helpful/entertaining/interesting)
